'''Chell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Five]], a small evil-worshipping cult that lived within the remote section of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. Chell and his compatriots spent [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] visitors to the Hellhoop&mdash;notably, the Five captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]]. Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Chell&mdash;who was romantically involved with fellow Five member [[Chokla]]&mdash;and his group captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], preparing to kill them for their amusement as they had so many wayward travelers. However, Chewbacca managed to release Wutzek from its prison, and the demon responded in kind by slaughtering every member of the Five&mdash;Chell, who was the first to discover Wutzek's escape, was the first to meet his end.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chell appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Chell was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
